purpose: Recent public fishing-community and fleet-report context. Regional reports may support Richmond Ray's explanation but do not alter a shoreline Trip Fit Index unless promoted into the exact-location Community Evidence Register.

scope.area: Richmond / San Pablo Bay / Central Bay

signals.summary: Current Richmond-area charter reviews/report pages describe active Bay halibut opportunity and strong September salmon activity.
signals.source_name: FishingBooker Richmond / Bay Area fishing reports
signals.caveat: Charter/boat reports are not treated as proof of shore-access bite quality.

signals.summary: Fish Emeryville reported a busy fleet with strong rockfish and salmon catches on September 19–20; the landing also advertises Bay halibut/striped-bass trips.
signals.caveat: Offshore/fleet catch totals do not establish shoreline success at Point Emery or nearby public access.

signals.summary: Bay Area anglers identified Point Pinole, Crockett, Point Molate, Richmond-Berkeley shoreline, Alameda, Brannan Island and Rio Vista as shore-fishing options; commenters emphasized tide movement for stripers.
signals.caveat: Older community reputation supports discovery, not current bite status.
